name: A Birmingham street

place_source.title: Wikidata: Birmingham, Alabama (Q79867), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: A residential street in Birmingham, Alabama, in the Ridge-and-Valley foothills: front-yard oaks, maples and dogwoods, hedges of American holly and eastern redcedar, and a garden visited by cardinals, chickadees and woodpeckers by day, by squirrels, chipmunks and green anoles in the sun, and by raccoons after dark.

facts.text: Birmingham has a humid subtropical climate (Köppen Cfa), with hot, humid summers and mild winters.

facts.text: The city sits in Jones Valley between the parallel ridges of the Appalachian foothills, drained by creeks that flow into the Black Warrior River.

facts.text: Birmingham's elevation is 187 m (614 ft) above sea level.
